name: Moon-Prayer Night Pamphlet
desc: A pamphlet handed out at Nasha Town's Moon-Prayer Night. It highlights a variety of fun booths and activities. With it in hand, guests are sure to enjoy an evening they won't soon forget.

desc.text: "Don't worry, you two. There's always another adventure waiting just around the corner."
"Don't worry, you two. There's always another adventure waiting just around the corner."
"...Could you give me a few that haven't been inflated yet?"
"I hope we meet again at the next festival!"
"...You'd better not lose, or I'm going to beat your head in."
"Thank you, Dori. I had a lot of fun."
"Assorted Moon-Prayer Candy! All your favorite flavors in a box!"
"I wish that all who dwell in this moonlit world can find a place to belong, and I wish that I shall one day see my friends again."
"My sugar sculpture has shrunk, yet my heart is filled with feelings of sweetness."
"My sugar sculpture has shrunk, yet my heart is filled with feelings of sweetness."

value.name: Return to the Moon
value.desc: It's time to begin the journey home...
